items.item: Sources/EPUB Rendering/EPUB.Package.swift: `EPUB.Package.Item.properties` is joined without XML es
items.reason: The joined properties go through escapeXML like the other attributes.

items.item: Sources/EPUB Rendering/EPUB.Package.swift: `EPUB.Package.xml` accepts spine idrefs that don't ma
items.reason: Checked against the manifest ids; a mismatch throws the new EPUB.Package.Error.unknownSpineItem(idref:) (typed error instead of the precondition the issue offered, since idrefs are caller input).

items.item: Sources/EPUB Rendering/EPUB.Navigation.swift: an empty item list produces a nav without the `<o
items.reason: Empty top-level items throw the new EPUB.Navigation.Error.empty; the h1 heading is a new required `heading:` parameter (escaped). Empty children of an entry still render no nested ol, which EPUB allows.

api_changes: New public enum EPUB.Package.Error { case unknownSpineItem(idref: String) }.
New public enum EPUB.Navigation.Error { case empty }.
dependents: None found: no package under /home/user/cloud-workspace/repos depends on swift-epub-render or calls EPUB.Package.xml / EPUB.Navigation.xhtml.
